items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I knew her in the bands

ctx.x: But as far as the mental processes that sounds very plausible with both of them.

Um-hm, this happens to singers you know, one very fine singer who is very underrated because of the image that she cultivated was Doris Day, who got so paranoid about performing she used to – you know I knew her in the bands [laughs] it reminds me of a great line Oscar Levant used to use, “I knew Doris Day before she was a virgin.”
